items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Then I stopped taking that treatment for a while. And then I went to the same man's brother out in Long Island a few times.

ctx.x: That's what you cry for. The combination of you and that person that is dead forever. Some part of you always goes with them, someone you know and love dearly who dies. And you cry for that part of yourself.
Then I stopped taking that treatment for a while. And then I went to the same man's brother out in Long Island a few times. Anyhow, it wasn't too long after that he died too.
